tools.name: security.chainbreak.analyze
tools.title: ChainBreak Policy Graph Analyze
tools.description: Runs deterministic ChainBreak LAB reachability analysis on an allowlisted fixture and persists tenant-isolated evidence in CompanyBrainStore.

tools.name: security.chainbreak.get
tools.title: ChainBreak Analysis Get
tools.description: Retrieves persisted SecurityAnalysis, ChainBreakEvidence, AdjudicationResult, RemediationSpec, and DecisionHistory scoped strictly to the caller tenantId.

tools.name: security.judge.evaluate
tools.title: JEV-as-a-Judge Advisory Evaluate
tools.description: Evaluates a persisted LAB analysis via deterministic pre-validations, sanitized TypeSafe JEV inference (or explicit offline mock), escalation policy, and deterministic risk checks.

tools.name: security.remediation.spec
tools.title: Defensive Remediation Spec
tools.description: Returns the minimal reviewable defensive RemediationSpec for an analyzed path with requiresHumanApproval=true and autoApplyAllowed=false.

tools.name: security.status
tools.title: Security Action Engine Status
tools.description: Reports component readiness, LAB-only boundary, JEV provider configuration status, and Harness2 feature flag status.

tools.name: security.audit.start
tools.title: Continuous Security Audit Start (LAB)
tools.description: Runs deterministic ChainBreak LAB audit on an allowlisted fixture, persists tenant-isolated analysis/evidence/remediation/adjudication in CompanyBrainStore, and returns redacted audit results.

tools.name: security.audit.get
tools.title: Continuous Security Audit Get (Tenant-Isolated)
tools.description: Retrieves a persisted, redacted security audit run (analysis, evidence, adjudications, remediationSpecs, decisionHistory) strictly scoped to the caller tenantId.

tools.name: security.evidence.get
tools.title: Security Evidence Get (Tenant-Isolated & Redacted)
tools.description: Retrieves persisted, redacted ChainBreakEvidence records by evidenceId and/or analysisId strictly scoped to the caller tenantId.

tools.name: security.kali.lab_run
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC Enumerated Verification Run
tools.description: Executes an enumerated Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC verification action (service_inventory, tls_review, web_passive_baseline, local_code_scan) with strict scopeRef, targetRef, budgetRef, zero raw shell, static `--` argv, and secret redaction.

tools.name: security.kali.service_inventory
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC Service Inventory
tools.description: Runs bounded LAB_SYNTHETIC TCP connect service inventory on allowlisted loopback/localnet targets using static `--` argv and redacts all banners/findings.

tools.name: security.kali.tls_review
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC TLS Posture Review
tools.description: Runs non-destructive LAB_SYNTHETIC TLS cipher and protocol posture review on allowlisted loopback/localnet targets.

tools.name: security.kali.web_passive_baseline
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC Web Passive Baseline
tools.description: Runs passive HTTP security header and CORS hygiene baseline assessment on allowlisted loopback/localnet targets.

tools.name: security.kali.local_code_scan
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC Airgapped Local Code & Dependency Scan
tools.description: Runs airgapped (--net=none) local workspace manifest and configuration scan with strict path containment and secret redaction.

tools.name: security.kali.get_run
tools.title: Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC Tenant-Isolated Run Lookup
tools.description: Retrieves a persisted, redacted Kali LAB_SYNTHETIC verification run strictly scoped to the authenticated caller tenantId.
